name: @qdnbd/dsh-panel-pins
description: Keyboard-first sidebar panel launcher for DeepSeek Harness: grouped searchable Panels menu with hit highlighting, Alt+1..9 direct jumps, MRU, mirrored by a Ctrl+K command palette with named layout presets. Pin/top/hide/rename rows, custom groups, icon-only mode, compact footer, full Settings page, and settings export/import via clipboard AND file. Display-layer only: no DOM surgery, clean uninstall, theme-token styling. Primary install name: dsh-panel-pins (this scoped package stays published for existing users).
author: QDNBD
